metadata.summary: The customer ordered a Cinnamon Raisin bagel with strawberry cream cheese for pickup.

messages.text: Hello there, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel, I'm BagelBot an AI Assistant, and How can I assist you today?
Hey. I just wanted to order a bagel for pickup.
Sure thing! What kind of bagel would you like for that?
Can I get a cinnamon raisin bagel?
Perfect! Cinnamon Raisin bagel it is. Would you like that toasted, lightly toasted, toasted dark, or not toasted at all?
Got it! That's a toasted Cinnamon Raisin bagel. Now, would you like to add any cream cheese or other spreads to your bagel? We have Plain,
I don't see Yak on our menu. We have Plain, Vegetable, Scallion, Strawberry, and several other options. Which would you prefer?
Perfect! Strawberry cream cheese it is. Is there anything else I can get for you today?
Okay, so I have a Cinnamon Raisin bagel with toasted and strawberry cream cheese. Let me get that all put together for you.
